summary: Gamehaus Holdings Inc., a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq-listed gaming firm operating through PRC and Hong Kong subsidiaries, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity program of up to US$11.64 million of Class A ordinary shares (GMHS) under a Sales Agreement dated November 10, 2026 with ARC Group Securities LLC as sales agent. The cap equals one-third of the roughly US$34.93 million non-affiliate public float, per Form F-3 General Instruction I.B.5. ARC earns a 3.0% commission; sales occur on Nasdaq at prevailing prices. No price, premium, or close date is set. Watch dilution pace, trading liquidity, and any acceleration of share sales below US$1.
